name: vocdoni-stripe
description: Stripe operations for the Vocdoni SaaS, run through the Stripe CLI (or a Stripe MCP server). Creates subscriptions for existing customers with the org-address metadata the backend needs, clones per-customer Custom / Integrator Starter plan products from the catalog templates, handles discounts and payment collection, and always confirms before writing. Ships an environment-guarding CLI wrapper, a product-cloning script and a verified reference of what the SaaS backend reads from Stripe.
